body: BLOCK exact f60b86c0f8727ea6403b37399be3e2a2ad887bce; this replaces my stale approval after the chief's newer .jvm-root finding reached my monitor. Independently reproduced in /private/tmp/storymodel4s-refscope-successor-review.Bemn2V: add SharedApi in core/src/main/scala with its only downstream consumer in features/.jvm/src/test/scala. The script exits 0 but emits only coreJVM/test, omitting required featuresJVM/test. Cause is exact: is_module_source recognizes only module/src/*.scala and consumer search greps only module/src, excluding lawful CrossType.Pure .jvm/src roots. Candidate must supersede with explicit shared plus .jvm extraction/search and a regression court; changed .js/.native roots must fail explicitly unless platform-specific emission is correctly implemented and tested. Earlier deletion/rename checks still pass but do not cure this dangerous narrow scope.
